task_text: A guest is coming over in 15 minutes. The house should feel welcoming — somewhere comfortable to sit, and something to offer them when they arrive.

central_instructions.R1: Prepare a light snack or beverage by picking up a light object from the kitchen and pass it to R2.
central_instructions.R2: Arrange the living room by pushing furniture if needed and receive the snack or beverage from R1 to place it on the table.
central_instructions.R3: Ensure the bedroom is tidy and assist in passing any light objects if needed.
central_instructions.R4: Check the bathroom for cleanliness and assist in passing any light objects if needed.

agent_plans.R1:
[0-5 min]
- R1 [LOCAL] Pick up the mug from the sink basin (r1_s1)

[5-10 min]
- R1 [PASS] Pass the mug to R2 (r1_s2)
- R2 [RECEIVE] Receive the mug from R1 (r2_s1)

[10-15 min]
- R2 [LOCAL] Place the mug on the table for the guest (r2_s2)
agent_plans.R2:
[0-5 min]
- R2 [LOCAL] Push the armchairs to create a more open seating area. (r2_s1)

[5-10 min]
- R2 [LOCAL] Adjust the coffee table to be centered in front of the sofa. (r2_s2)
- R1 [PASS] Bring a snack or beverage to the living room. (r1_s1)

[10-15 min]
- R2 [RECEIVE] Receive the snack or beverage from R1. (r2_s3)
- R2 [LOCAL] Place the snack or beverage on the coffee table. (r2_s4)
